title: Projects: settings shared by every file

steps.say: A second document, annex.qmd, has none of the report's settings: no contents list, no embedding. Copying the header into every file drifts.
_quarto.yml makes the folder a project. quarto render with no file name renders every document, into _output.
And every document inherits the project's settings: the annex now has a contents list and travels as one file, with no change to annex.qmd.
freeze: auto stores each document's results in _freeze/. Render again and no processing file appears: R did not run. It reruns only when the .qmd changes.

final:
project:
  output-dir: _output

format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true

execute:
  freeze: auto
